sources.title: Approved Gombe LGAs Approved 2025 Budgets
sources.access: Official search-index excerpt read; direct page timed out on verification attempt.
sources.supports: The ministry index lists all eleven LGA budget headings; only administrative membership is used.
sources.limitations: Budget figures and present-day administrative changes are not teaching facts; index spelling Yalmatu Deba is normalised to Yamaltu-Deba.

sources.title: Gombe State Development Plan 2021-2030
sources.access: Official listing and search excerpt read; full plan not fetched or audited.
sources.supports: Existence of a state development-plan listing.
sources.limitations: 2020-2030 abridged and 2021-2030 listings coexist. No detailed cultural or geographic claim is attributed to an unread edition.

sources.title: Gombe forenames
sources.limitations: No ranks, counts or representativeness claim verified; not evidence of a child's ethnicity, faith, language or LGA origin.

sources.title: Forebears name distribution and demographics methodology
sources.supports: The service describes approximate incidence and sampling limitations.
sources.limitations: Incomplete, uneven and dated samples can alter rankings; names are not a child-population census or proof of cultural identity.

sources.title: Tangale Cultural Heritage
sources.supports: A documented 2023-2024 heritage project includes Tangale-language preservation and names Billiri, Kaltungo and Shongom among its areas.
sources.limitations: A project description does not verify specific garments, motifs, recipes, festivals or migration history for pupil narration. Named customs need community review and additional evidence.

required: Local educators and families review names, clothing, household settings and speech.
Ask community knowledge holders before using named cultural practices or heritage motifs.
Check preferred local spellings and pronunciation with local reviewers.
Verify map geometry and any routes separately before publishing maps.

quantity_policy: Every story amount is fictional teaching material, never real population, price, harvest, travel-time or capacity data. Exact assessed marks, coins, clocks, graphs, fractions and counters are deterministic diagrams.
